name: 02-first-look-esp32
description: The board that just came back: every module, and what sits inside each one.

steps.caption: Control: a remote, a button or a fader, pointed at anything on this page.
Layouts: where your lights physically are.
Grid: width, height and depth, applied while it runs.
Effects: what they show, stacked in layers.
Layer: one effect and its modifiers, blended onto the ones below.
Drivers: how the finished frame reaches the lights.
OnboardLed: the single light on the board itself.
RmtLed: the real strip, on a pin, driven by the RMT peripheral.
NetworkSend: the same frame as ArtNet, E1.31 or DDP, to anything that listens.
System: the board itself, its chip, its uptime, how fast it renders.
Tasks: what runs each frame, and what each costs in microseconds.
I2cScan: finds the chips on the I2C bus.
Pins: which pin every module has claimed, so two never fight over one.
File Manager: every file on the board, and one button that backs them all up.
Network: the WiFi it joined, and the other devices it can see.
Mqtt: a broker, for a home automation system.
Devices: every other MoonLight on the network, found on their own.
Services: the inputs.
Audio: this board has a microphone, so it is listening to the room.
Firmware: it finds the next release and installs it over the air.
MoonCloud: see what everyone else is running.
Stats: what this device shares, and the totals it gets back.
Talk: ask a question without leaving the page.
